description:
Calculate a price preview for complete ride facts without contact details. Use for pricing; prepare_offer creates an explicitly requested new offer, while prepare_booking_change reviews an existing booking's amendment.

Keep ride times in the timeZone returned for the same offerKey. Return service needs its later return pickup; hourly service needs one_way and duration. Vehicle preference and specialRequests share a 500-character combined note limit, including the preference label and separator: individually valid fields can together exceed it. Keep volunteered requirements intact; ask for clarification rather than silently truncate them.

quoted returns a price/tax/inclusion breakdown by leg, not reserved capacity. Route/pricing reads consume quote admission and repeated calls may differ. Revalidate before an offer. Wait retryAfterSeconds on rate_limited; follow review_required guidance. No offer, reservation, charge or message is created.

locale.description: Use the customer's requested language for text and booking links: en by default, de for German. Preserve it on retries; pickup times stay in the provider time zone.

offerKey.description: Optional existing published provider/supplier offer key. Selects its configured service location; it is not a customer bookingKey or bookingReference and grants no booking access.

ride.description: Ride facts with distinct pickup/destination and valid local dates/times. Return requires returnDate/returnTime after pickup; one_way omits both. Hourly requires one_way and hours; transfers omit hours.

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD in the provider timeZone returned by get_service_options; resolve relative dates first.

destination.description: Destination distinct from pickup, with city/municipality or postcode; e.g. München Hauptbahnhof, 80335 München. For hourly service describe the planned route or As directed.

flightNumber.description: Flight number for an airport pickup, such as LH123; omit when not applicable.

hours.description: Booked duration for hourly service; omit for transfers.

luggage.description: Luggage count/type or fit requirements; unusual luggage may require review.

passengers.description: Total people travelling; determines vehicle requirements, not availability or acceptance.

pickup.description: Pickup address or named place with city/municipality or postcode; e.g. Flughafen München (MUC), 85356 München-Flughafen.

returnDate.description: Return pickup date in the same local format as date, in the provider timeZone; provide only for return trips, after the outbound pickup.

returnTime.description: Return pickup time in the same local format as time and the same provider timeZone; provide only for return trips.

serviceType.description: Set hourly for service booked by duration; omit for transfers.

time.description: Local pickup time in 24-hour HH:mm format, in the provider timeZone (Samuelz: Europe/Berlin); not UTC or an offset timestamp.

tripType.description: one_way for a single transfer or hourly service; return for outbound plus a separate later return transfer.

vehiclePreference.description: Volunteered vehicle preference only; no class, price or availability guarantee. Additional requirements may require review.

specialRequests.description: Optional ride requirements, at most 500 characters. Additional stops or unusual requirements may require review; do not include contact details in a quote.

quote.description: Calculated price preview and tax/inclusion breakdown; no reservation or availability confirmation.

billableHoursPerServiceLine.description: Billable hours used for each calculated service line.

calculatedAt.description: Timestamp of this preview calculation, not a guaranteed price-validity window.

grossTotalCents.description: Gross total of the preview in the returned currency's minor units (EUR cents).

parkingIncluded.description: Whether parking costs are included in the preview.

pricesIncludeVat.description: Whether the returned price includes VAT.

revalidationRequired.description: Revalidate price and terms before preparing or confirming an offer.

serviceLines.description: Price breakdown by outbound/return service line.

direction.description: The outbound or return leg priced by this service line.

grossAmountCents.description: Gross price for this service line in the returned currency's minor units.

tollsIncluded.description: Whether toll costs are included in the preview.

vatRateBasisPoints.description: VAT rate in basis points: 10000 basis points equal 100 percent.

vehicleCount.description: Vehicle count used in this price calculation, not confirmed vehicle availability.
